build.qualification: Benchmark-only source snapshot adds one harness=false bench registration; production src bytes match the working tree. Clock-free accounting is separate from timing.

timing.qualification: Fixed-order per-operation clocks for every mode, with equal timer overhead retained. In-place decode excludes source restoration; a separate restore-only mode and combined restoration+decode mode report its cost. Caller allocation/setup and ledger bookkeeping are excluded. All scratch allocation/drop and frame validation are included. No universal unsafe benefit or desktop idleness is claimed.

repeat_timing.qualification: Fixed-order per-operation clocks for every mode, with equal timer overhead retained. In-place decode excludes source restoration; a separate restore-only mode and combined restoration+decode mode report its cost. Caller allocation/setup and ledger bookkeeping are excluded. All scratch allocation/drop and frame validation are included. No universal unsafe benefit or desktop idleness is claimed.

summary.aggregation: Equal-weight geometric mean of per-case median latency ratios over ten nonempty cases. Empty remains separate. Source restoration is separately measured and also included in combined mode. Equal timer overhead retained, no confidence intervals or general speedup claim.

qualification: Fixed-order sequential measurements on this host, with task-owned compiler/test jobs completed before the recorded CPU barrier. No claim of desktop idleness, statistical significance, architecture independence or general unsafe speedup. Primary contains safe/all/21 isolated backends; independent rebuilt repeat contains safe/all. Allocation qualification is separate from timing. Every sample is retained. All measured fixture payloads are archived; unused historical binary fixtures are identified by the complete frozen source inventory rather than duplicated into this timing archive.
